title: The Book of Kith and Kin

paragraphs.text: The Book of Kith and Kin is a collection of stories that is particularly important to the Kithkin of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor .

The Book of Kith and Kin is a tome that holds the collected cultural heritage of all kithkin. After the New Phyrexian Invasion , as many kithkin opened their society to other inhabitants of the plane, the book is regularly updated with new passages as kithkin towns and villages expand to welcome other creatures.
